import json
import shlex
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone

OUT=Path('/Users/alexy/src/grust/docs/reviews/sail-stream-experiments-2026-09-30/logging03-physical-execution')
REMOTE=r'''
import json,subprocess,uuid,re
from datetime import datetime,timezone
d=['/usr/local/bin/docker','--context','colima-sail-gate']
token=uuid.uuid4().hex
report={'started_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'scope':'Read-only ownership/mode metadata for checker input paths; no graph values read.','commands':[],'token':token}
cid=None
def run(args):
 p=subprocess.run(d+args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60)
 report['commands'].append({'command':d+args,'returncode':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr})
 p.check_returncode();return p.stdout
try:
 assert not run(['ps','-q']).strip()
 paths=['/targets','/targets/graph-nuts-ffcfbd569','/targets/graph-nuts-ffcfbd569/venv','/targets/graph-nuts-ffcfbd569/venv/bin','/targets/graph-nuts-ffcfbd569/venv/bin/python','/targets/sail-stream-experiments-20260930','/targets/sail-stream-experiments-20260930/logging03-compact','/targets/sail-stream-experiments-20260930/logging03-compact/cells','/targets/sail-stream-experiments-20260930/logging03-compact/cells/stream-log03-compact-r1-scale24-pecan-sssp-delta_star','/targets/sail-stream-experiments-20260930/logging03-compact/cells/stream-log03-compact-r1-scale24-pecan-sssp-delta_star/result','/work','/work/container_check.py','/evidence']
 import shlex
 script='id && stat -c "%n %u:%g %a" '+shlex.join(paths)
 cid=run(['create','--name','physical-permission-'+token,'--label','physical-permission.token='+token,'--pull=never','--user=0:20','--read-only','--network=none','--cpus=1','--memory=268435456','--memory-swap=268435456','--pids-limit=32','--workdir=/targets','--cap-drop=ALL','--security-opt=no-new-privileges','--mount','type=volume,source=sail-extension-targets,target=/targets,readonly,volume-nocopy','--mount','type=bind,source=/Users/alexy/src/sail-extensions-gates/stream-experiments-20260930/physical-output-log03-35fba73999e241c2-v3-bundle,target=/work,readonly','--mount','type=bind,source=/Users/alexy/src/sail-extensions-gates/stream-experiments-20260930/physical-output-log03-35fba73999e241c2-v3-evidence,target=/evidence,readonly','--entrypoint=/bin/sh','sha256:f3518d652fbea8b9b9f9ebf9849277ca3bd39d0c21bb2c6e36fbaeaa2dc2678e','-c',script]).strip()
 assert re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}',cid)
 report['container_id']=cid
 run(['start','-a',cid])
except BaseException as error:
 report['error']=repr(error)
finally:
 if cid:
  try:
   state=json.loads(run(['inspect','--format','{"Id":{{json .Id}},"State":{{json .State}},"Labels":{{json .Config.Labels}},"User":{{json .Config.User}}}',cid]))
   report['inspect']=state
   assert state['Id']==cid and state['Labels']['physical-permission.token']==token
   assert state['State']['Running'] is False
   run(['logs',cid]);run(['rm',cid]);report['cleanup']='removed_after_state_capture'
  except BaseException as error:report['cleanup_error']=repr(error)
 report['finished_utc']=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
print(json.dumps(report))
'''
record=dict(started_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),source=Path(__file__).read_text())
p=subprocess.run(['ssh','morrobay','/usr/local/bin/python3 -I -B -c '+shlex.quote(REMOTE)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180)
record.update(finished_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),returncode=p.returncode,stdout=p.stdout,stderr=p.stderr)
with (OUT/'target-permission-control02.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(record,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
p.check_returncode()
data=json.loads(p.stdout)
for row in data['commands']:
 if row['command'][3:5]==['start','-a']:print(row['stdout'],row['stderr'])
print(json.dumps({k:data.get(k) for k in ('error','inspect','cleanup','cleanup_error')}))
